models.$comment: design — только для поиска кандидатов голоса (--audition); реплики озвучивает clone

personas: Elderly Russian woman, about 75 years old, a kind grandmother playing cards. Clearly aged voice: lower pitch, soft and slightly husky timbre with a light rasp of old age, a little breathy. Warm, cheerful and a bit sly. Unhurried tempo, natural Russian intonation.

A Russian babushka in her late seventies. Mature, low female voice with natural old-age texture and a slight creak at the ends of phrases. Warm, motherly, playful and good-humored. Relaxed tempo, clear diction.
Old Russian grandmother, about 80 years old. Aged, slightly hoarse and gravelly voice, lower register, gentle and kind, with a mischievous smile in it. Speaks at a calm, measured pace.

Elderly Russian grandmother, about 75 years old, with a low, deep, velvety alto voice. Languid and drawling, unhurried, slightly lazy and sultry manner of speaking, with long soft vowels. A light natural huskiness and gentle rasp in the voice. Warm, sly and affectionate.

Old Russian woman in her seventies with a low-pitched chest voice. Slow, languorous, sing-song delivery, as if savoring every word. Slightly hoarse, smoky timbre with a soft breathy rasp. Kind, cunning and amused.

Clearly a woman's voice: an elderly Russian grandmother, about 75, speaking in a low female alto, lower than usual but still feminine. Languid, drawling and unhurried, with soft lingering vowels. Slightly hoarse and husky, a gentle smoker-like rasp. Warm, sly and affectionate.

reference.$comment: Эталонная фраза: VoiceDesign создаёт по ней голос (описание personas[personaIndex]), базовая модель затем озвучивает этим голосом все реплики. Кандидатов голоса даёт --audition.
reference.text: Ну, здра́вствуй, со́лнышко. Сади́сь, сыгра́ем в дура́чка.
